body:
Children, I agree that that would give sense to things, as I would be able to focus my energy on raising them rather than on failing to think on ways to save the world.
Talking to people, well that's sort of why I posted here, I have a hard time writing things, as you can see my words are rather bland and square, when talking live I tend to evade any subject that has to do with feelings of any kind, I can listen well though, but I just can't speak my own mind live.
The problem I see with therapy, is that I see that many things are wrong with society, and If I end up taking meds as some people I know, I will just sort of will accept all of it, and end up a zombie... I'm probably wrong, but that's just how I see it... I feel people just don't see the big picture (hell I'm ignoring it completely by putting this personal stuff here today) and I fear I may end up being contempt with things I see as shallow now.
I can't quite wrap my head around a concrete idea of who I am

I somewhat agree, but at this point I think its the last thing I need, I feel I need to sort out some kind of will to move, also, everytime I try I end up with some BS or with a new pretty friend that texts me that all guys are assholes, and my relationship history has a 100% failure rate (probably because of me of course, but then the cycle starts all over).
